race.description: RMBL Investments Rising Stars Race Hcp (Bm56)
race.comment: BRUTIFY (7) is going well this time in. Placed fresh then relished the heavy ground last time with a strong win. More weight but yet to miss the frame in three tries in the heavy and fitter again. Go well. RUSSIAN FRONT (3) was runner-up here two back then tackled a tougher race last time at Sandown Lakeside. Comes back a notch and gets chance to atone. GET HONOR (5) has more upside than most having had just three starts including a debut win. Fitter for three jump-outs and returns with the blinkers. Expected to measure up. ATELLA MISS (6) was off the mark last time and can measure up again. PUNIC WAR (9) will find the easier and looks a good each way hope.
